title: Liposuction Malaysia by Specialist Plastic Surgeon | Remove Stubborn Fat Safely – Dr. Soma
description: Looking for safe, surgeon-performed liposuction in Malaysia? Dr. Soma offers advanced body contouring using MicroAire Power-Assisted Liposuction for long-lasting, natural results.

acceptedAnswer.text: A surgical fat-removal procedure that contours and reshapes specific areas of the body by removing excess subcutaneous fat.
Small incisions are made, a fine cannula is inserted, and fat is suctioned out using MicroAire Power-Assisted technology for smoother results and reduced trauma.

mainEntity.name: When will I see results after liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll start noticing changes at 4–6 weeks, with the final shape visible between 3–6 months as swelling subsides.
Results are long-lasting because fat cells removed do not regenerate. Maintaining stable weight preserves contour.

mainEntity.name: Can I lose 10 kg with liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Liposuction is not for weight loss. It removes volume and contours the body, not kilograms.
Pain is usually mild to moderate — similar to muscle soreness after an intense workout. Medication keeps discomfort manageable.

mainEntity.name: Is liposuction good or bad for you?

acceptedAnswer.text: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon, liposuction is safe, effective, and one of the most common aesthetic surgeries globally.

mainEntity.name: What is the best age to get liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most suitable for adults aged 20–60 with good skin elasticity.

mainEntity.name: Is your stomach flat after liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — if your main issue is excess fat. If loose skin is present, a Tummy Tuck may be recommended.
Risks are low when done by a trained surgeon in a hospital setting. Dr. Soma performs liposuction with full monitoring and controlled safety protocols.

mainEntity.name: What body part is most painful for liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Areas with tighter skin (e.g., flanks or inner thighs) may feel slightly more sore, but pain is manageable.

mainEntity.name: How long is bed rest after liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are encouraged to walk immediately after surgery. Most patients return to normal routines within 5–7 days.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to lose weight before liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessary — but being at a stable, healthy weight gives better contouring results.
Only tiny (3–4mm) incisions hidden in natural creases. They fade significantly with time.
